findings.message: '_' is assigned a value and nothing ever reads it. A name that is written but never read is almost always the residue of an edit that moved on: an import whose call site was deleted, a parameter left behind when a signature changed, a variable holding a value nobody asked for. It costs nothing at runtime, which is what lets it accumulate, and it costs the next reader real time, because an unused name reads exactly like a used one until you search the file and find nothing. Delete it.

clean.source:
import { foo } from 'foo';
export type Foo = typeof foo;
